description: The one shape both pipe contracts carry, so that the folder layout has an import that leaves one folder and enters another.

This directory is the collision fixture: `pipe.rpc` and `pipe.events` each declare their own `Session`, which the format permits — type names are unique within a manifest, not across a directory — and which one flat directory of `<Type>.ts` files cannot write. The manifests are a checklist for the folder layout the way `demo.every` is a checklist for the mapping.

types.name: Meta
description: When something happened, shared by both contracts rather than restated in each.

fields.name: timestamp_ms
description: Milliseconds since the epoch, assigned by the producer. Many orders of magnitude inside the safe range, so declared exact rather than wide.
